runtime: node 22, express 4, ws; PostgreSQL 18 via openvibe-sdk/db (pg, or embedded PGlite in tests); Valkey optional; no build step
deployment: Production at https://openvibe.bot on openvibe-ovh since 2026-10-02: release layout /opt/openvibe.bot, unit openvibe-bot.service (WorkingDirectory /opt/openvibe.bot, EnvironmentFile /etc/openvibe/bot.env, PORT 4630, TimeoutStopSec 10), behind the nginx vhost deploy/nginx/openvibe.bot.conf, deployed with `ov deploy bot`. Liveness /api/health and readiness /api/ready are loopback-only.
features: device WebSocket /device: one outbound socket per machine, credential or Network node token, heartbeat and telemetry, commands never replayed after a reconnect

operator WebSocket /control and the REST API (/api/v1, including POST /robots/:id/commands so a bound channel's chat can forward a command over HTTP) over one command gate: roles, per-robot limits and allowlists, cooldowns and the turn budget
pairing with one-time codes, minted by Bot or delegated to OpenVibe.Network (BOT_PAIRING_AUTHORITY=network); a node machine binds on first use and reauths every 300 s
device credentials hashed at rest and rotatable; revoke closes the socket at once and revokes the Network principal for a node machine

catalogue profiles adeept.adr036 (+ mecanum variant), cozmo, camera.onvif, sim.rover and relay.generic (the bare relay robot OpenVibe.Live's controls convert to) seeded from server/profiles/*.json; owner-edited robot-local button and video-click profiles stored with each robot

curated kit catalogue (server/kits/*.json; GET /api/v1/kits, /kits/:id): each kit's parts list and build guide, validated and bound to a shipped profile — the Adeept ADR036 first; metadata only (pricing, shipping and returns are O29)
a latched e-stop only the owner clears, with halt always allowed, and a device-side deadman deadline on the motion kinds
command audit kept 30 days, and the bot.robot.online/offline, bot.estop.set/cleared and bot.command.refused outbox events
public robot-profile catalogue (GET /profiles, /profiles/:id); robots are private to their owner, with public control only as a timed turn queue
per-actor limits on capability-boundary writes (openvibe-sdk/limits; shared through Valkey when VALKEY_URL is set)

signed-in pages: /robots (list and add), /pair/:id (the code and the one-paste installer command) and /panel/:id, rendered from the robot's profile and driven over /control; a sim.rover robot is driven by an in-process simulated device

the panel's People card: the owner adds an operator or viewer by @username (OpenVibe.Network resolves the name to a subject) and removes them again, shown with Network's names; a signed-in visitor on an open-queue robot sees their turn or their place in line and can leave the queue, promoting the next person (POST /robots/:id/operators and …/operators/:subject/remove, POST /robots/:id/queue/leave)

panel input: a touch joystick, the keyboard and a gamepad (Gamepad API), each held control re-sent while held and zeroed at once on release; a latency meter (round-trip median and telemetry age); one camera tile per camera the profile lists (a placeholder until OpenRe can play a WHIP stream back); a live online indicator on /pair/:id read from /control

platform.job@1 jobs dispatched to a paired Node over /device (platform.job-frame@1: resent unacked on reconnect, only to an advertised runtime class) and metered per second into run_usage_outbox for billing.usage.record

embed opt-in: robots.embed_public (migration 0005), set only by the owner with POST /robots/:id/embed, web-only (not in /api/v1); BOT_EMBED_ORIGINS is the validated frame-ancestors allow-list for the embeddable panel (default OpenVibe.Live)

embeddable panel: GET /panel/:id/embed framed only by BOT_EMBED_ORIGINS (no cookie, never a sign-in redirect; a member keeps their role, anyone else watches an embed_public robot) and the anonymous read-only /watch socket carrying the public state (online, e-stop, latency, battery, the profile's readouts), capped per address and per robot

streaming and recording toggles per robot, off by default and owner-only: media records live sessions to OpenVibe.Media (the OpenRe stream's recording_mode vod/none) and live shows them on the owner's OpenVibe.Live channel (mirror_to_live), read at GET /api/v1/robots/:id/streaming and set at POST /api/v1/robots/:id/streaming; Bot stores no copy, each real change audits once

server-side ONVIF cameras (profile camera.onvif, driver onvif, server/onvif): an in-process device beside the simulator attaches a camera configured with BOT_ONVIF_CAMERAS (its URL plus username_ref/password_ref secret references, never in the profile or in clear), writes a real kind server device row, translates ptz commands to ONVIF ContinuousMove/Stop with the profile deadline as a deadman, and carries the camera's GetStatus readout in telemetry; every request goes only to the configured host, with a timeout and no redirects
